# Tecnavis Web Solutions

> Tecnavis Web Solutions Pvt Ltd is a web development, e-commerce, mobile app and custom software company based in Malappuram, Kerala, India. It serves clients in Malappuram, across Kerala, India and abroad.

## Contact
- Website: https://www.tecnavis.in/
- Address: Malappuram, Kerala 676505, India
- Phone: +91 62824 14031
- Email: info@tecnavis.in
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 9:30 AM to 6:00 PM IST
- Google Maps: https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Tecnavis+Web+Solutions+Malappuram

## Services
- Websites: custom-designed marketing sites, dashboards and client portals (Laravel, React, Node)
- E-commerce: online stores with catalogue, checkout and admin panel
- App development: mobile apps built with Flutter, with backend and admin
- Custom software: business systems and ERP
- Digital marketing
